title: Sagalla language - Wikipedia
text: Sagalla (also known as Kisagala, Kisagalla, Sagala, Teri or Saghala) [3] is a Bantu language of Kenya. [4][5] It is closely related to the Chaga languages of Kenya and Tanzania. [citation needed]

title: Languages of Kenya - Wikipedia
text: Languages spoken locally belong to three broad language families: Niger-Congo (Bantu branch), Nilo-Saharan (Nilotic branch) and Afroasiatic (Cushitic). They are spoken by the country's Bantu, Nilotic and Cushitic populations respectively.
